text:
Sam: quick pass — closed XStream (mid-market). Passing to CS for onboarding + support triage. Main asks: private VPC, SSO (Okta), and dedicated capacity for burst. Renewal reminder: 12/01/2026 (they want annual invoice). Risk: integration timeline may push them toward competitor demo.

Emily: thanks! tagging @Sam for intro thread to champions. I’ll own kickoff + enablement. Need: org admin contact, expected monthly qps, and sample prompts. Can we get an architecture diagram?

Sam: champions are Priya (CTO) and Marco (PM). Priya ok with private deploy but wants data residency guarantees. Monthly qps ~ 60k tokens/day for first 3 months, peak bursts to 180k. I uploaded the signed SOW to the deal record.

Emily: noted. prepping onboarding plan. Tentative timeline: kickoff this week, SSO test next week, private VPC provision within 10 business days, then 2-week pilot.

Mina: looping eng — key infra asks: will they want model pinning to a quantized variant? if so we need model artifact and sequence-length profile. Also need expected concurrency and KV-cache size estimate.

Jamie: support here — we’ll need runbook + escalation path. Please provide sample failure cases they care about (e.g., tail latency >500ms, model quality regression). Also grant support view-only access to their logs and metrics during trial.

Sam: sample prompts attached in deal doc (link). They flagged hallucination tolerance for financial content as top priority.

Emily: creating consolidated checklist. Action items:
- Emily: schedule kickoff (owner: Emily) — aim Fri EOD.
- Sam: intro email to Priya + Marco with shared calendar invite (owner: Sam).
- Mina: create ENG ticket with infra requirements and model-pin recommendation (owner: Mina).
- Jamie: draft support runbook and define SLOs we’ll monitor (owner: Jamie).
- ops-bot: provision trial VPC + 2 dedicated nodes (owner: ops-bot).

Mina: creating ENG ticket now: ENG-7891. Content snippet:```
customer: XStream
vpc: private
dedicated_nodes: 2
expected_qps: 60k/day
model_pin: TBD
sequence_profile: short->60% mid->30% long->10%
```

ops-bot: ticket created CS-5217 (onboarding), infra request forwarded to eng queue.

Jamie: I’ll prep runbook template and drop it in this thread. Can CS get confirmation on who will be first point of contact during pilot?

Emily: Priya is preferred contact for infra, Marco for use-case feedback. I’ll send calendar invites and a short agenda.

Sam: intro email sent, included the champions and requested dates.

Emily: closing loop — next sync after kickoff. tagging owners: @Mina (ENG) to update ENG-7891, @Jamie (Support) to share runbook, @ops-bot to confirm provisioning ETA. Thanks all :thumbsup:
